question: Does a galaxy's internal dynamics change when it sits inside a cluster?
measure: Y = log10 sigma_e_tot, the flux-weighted aperture second velocity moment of the STARS inside 1 Re: sigma_e_tot^2 = <V^2 + sigma^2>_F

cross_survey_validation.note: MaNGA sigma_e_tot measured here inside 1 NSA-elpetro Re; SAMI inside 1 MGE Re. env-data measured the two surveys size scales to differ by +0.179 dex, so an aperture-definition offset of this size and sign is expected. Irrelevant to the differential result -- each survey supplies BOTH arms, so a constant zero point cancels exactly in the paired difference -- but it forbids pooling at galaxy level.
